SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_file_size_per_scan_minute
FROM scans AS sc
JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL
  AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL
  AND sc.spanmin <> 0
GROUP BY s.riskeval;
